messages:
anya: Uploaded a raw checkpoint for augury13b to s3, tagging here so conversion can start. path: s3://redwood-weights/augury13b/raw/v1/ - files are .pt shards (tp layout unknown). planning safetensors conversion + fp16 target.

jordan: thanks. do we know tensor-parallel layout / original TP size? that affects shard layout.

anya: not documented in the upload. looks like 2-way TP from the shard counts but want to confirm. sample listing:
```
$ aws s3 ls s3://redwood-weights/augury13b/raw/v1/
846M  00:12 00001-of-00008.pt
849M  00:12 00002-of-00008.pt
...  00008-of-00008.pt
```

kevin: if it's 8 shards total and model uses TP=2, likely per-rank shards are 4 each. but we should validate by checking param shapes after load.

li: quick tokenizer note: tokenizer.json is missing bos_token and has unknown added_tokens list. when I ran a quick encode I saw off-by-one on prompt tokens. please run a tokenizer sanity check before packaging.

anya: good catch @li. i'll run tokenizer test. can someone run the conversion pipeline with a dry-run to emit shapes? here's the command i'm proposing:
```
python scripts/convert_checkpoint.py \\
  --in s3://redwood-weights/augury13b/raw/v1/ \\
  --out /tmp/augury13b-convert/ \\
  --format safetensors \\
  --dtype fp16 \\
  --tp 2 \\
  --shard-count 8 \\
  --dry-run
```

jordan: run that on a GPU node with 64GB mem. set --dry-run to only load and print tensor shapes. if shapes mismatch expected TP partitioning we abort.

build-bot: CI job queued: conv-augury13b-dryrun on node gpu-02 (req: 64GB). job id: conv-1968004321-01.

kevin: also verify config.json keys before final packaging: we expect keys: "model_type", "hidden_size", "num_attention_heads", "tp_size", "shard_map". missing or swapped names will break runtime mapping.

li: tokenizer test results: bos_token_id missing, eos_token_id present but equals 0. sample: encode('Hello') -> tokens start with 1 instead of expected 50256. i patched tokenizer.json locally: set "bos_token_id": 50256 and added a small token mapping fix.

anya: thanks. i'll include the tokenizer patch in the packaging step and re-run dry-run.

jordan: one more subtlety: safetensors ordering must match our serving index. add an index file with metadata (tp_size, shard_count, original_order). otherwise our shard-fallthrough logic won't remap correctly.

kevin: agreed. add a JSON sidecar: augury13b.safetensors.meta.json with keys: ["format","dtype","tp_size","shard_count","file_order"]. we can generate from the converter.

anya: conv dry-run finished on gpu-02. shapes look consistent with TP=2 partitioning. converter printed per-shard mapping. attaching snippet:
```
shard 0: [layer.0.attn.qkv.weight] -> (3072, 4096) -> assigned tp_rank 0
shard 1: ... tp_rank 1
...
```

kevin: good. next step: full convert (non-dry-run) to s3 target and then run serve-readiness checklist: tokenizer sanity, config validation, sample generate smoke test, and perf quick-bench (1-2 concurrent streams).

li: i'll run tokenizer smoke tests after full convert. leave a note in the package meta about the tokenizer patch applied.

anya: starting full convert now. command same as before but without --dry-run and out -> s3://redwood-weights/augury13b/packaged/v1/ . I'll add the meta.json and tokenizer_patch.txt. ping me if anything fails. :rocket:

build-bot: CI job started: conv-augury13b-full on node gpu-04. job id: conv-1968004321-02. logs: https://ci.internal/conv-1968004321-02

jordan: "+1 on process. after upload i'll kick the serve smoke infra tests and leave a final signoff here. if perf is bad we may try bf16 for fp32-sensitive ops, or suggest quantization profile.

anya: uploaded packaged files to s3 and meta created. s3://redwood-weights/augury13b/packaged/v1/ contains:
- model-00001.safetensors ... model-00008.safetensors
- augury13b.safetensors.meta.json
- tokenizer_patch.txt
- packaging.log

kevin: I'll start serve smoke tests now. quick checklist I'm running:
- config.json schema validation
- tokenizer encode/decode symmetry
- sample generation (prompt: "The capital of France is")
- per-token latency baseline (seq_len 128)

li: tokenizer symmetry passed with the patched tokenizer. sample generation looks reasonable (no <unk> leaks).

build-bot: Serve smoke job queued: serve-smoke-1968004321 on test-cluster.

jordan: if smoke passes I'll mark this ready for onboard and create the model entry in the catalog with recommended run config: {"dtype":"fp16","tp":2,"shard_count":8,"quant_profile":null}.

anya: smoke passed. perf baseline: 12ms/token @128 with batch=1 on p4d-sim. leaving a note to revisit if production p99s spike. marking ready. :white_check_mark:
